topic.para: This guide describes a basic &ha; cluster that can be used for testing purposes. To expand this cluster for use in production environments, more steps are recommended:

listitem.para: If required, add more nodes to the cluster using the crm cluster join script.
Before using the cluster in a production environment, replace softdog with a hardware watchdog.
To configure a new watchdog device, see Setting up the &sbd; watchdog.
To replace softdog with a hardware watchdog, see Changing the &sbd; watchdog device.
For critical workloads, we highly recommend having two or three fencing devices, using either physical devices or disk-based &sbd;.
To switch to disk-based &sbd;, see Changing diskless &sbd; to disk-based &sbd;.
To add a physical fencing device, see Configuring Node Fencing in a &ha; Cluster.

&qdevice; and &qnet; help the cluster make quorum calculations in a split-brain scenario, so the cluster can sustain more node failures than the standard quorum rules allow. We recommend using &qdevice; and &qnet; in clusters with an even number of nodes, and especially in two-node clusters.
See Configuring &qdevice; and &qnet; in an Existing &ha; Cluster.
